{
  "project": "hive-research-gpu",
  "what_building": "A research paper summarization and surrogate generation service that processes academic papers, particularly in multi-agent systems and reinforcement learning. It uses a pipeline to extract sections and generate summaries or surrogates from paper content.",
  "pipeline": [
    "extract_sections",
    "summarize_section",
    "summarize_figures",
    "build_surrogate"
  ],
  "inputs": [
    "paper_title",
    "abstract",
    "experimental setup",
    "figures",
    "research questions"
  ],
  "outputs": [
    "section-wise summaries",
    "surrogates",
    "briefs"
  ],
  "confidence": 0.85,
  "evidence_quotes": [
    "heuristic guess: paper-surrogate / research-paper summarizer :: paper sections (abstract/figures/experiments) -> section-wise summarization prompts -> surrogates/summaries",
    "schema hints: ['abstract', 'brief', 'experimental setup', 'figures available', 'knowledge graph', 'research questions']",
    "templates: (x5) Title: {{paper_title}} ## abstract AOAD-MAT: Transformer-based Multi-Agent...",
    "query_types: {'chat': 228, 'research': 27, 'context-heavy': 17, 'chart/price': 5}"
  ]
}
